reconciliation_notes: The repository's seeded skills.json reports a Transformations category count of 18, consistent with the canonical CaC roster, although the seeded index status means category membership alone is not proof of mechanics or acquisition.
Kaioken x3 and Kaioken x20 are stages of the Kaioken Awoken skill rather than separate transformation records for the 18-record roster count.
Super Saiyan 2 and Super Saiyan 3 are stages of the Super Saiyan Awoken chain; Super Vegeta 2 is the second stage of the Super Vegeta chain.
The Power to Overcome is retained as the 18th CaC Awoken entry and remains DLC-gated; its detailed stage mechanics are still partially verified in batch 4.
No additional cast-only transformation was promoted into the CaC roster merely because a playable character or enemy uses it.
